records.text: "mauirt lai ki pungu kahuy lia ka kakanen nimisiw lia aku," mangesen lia

senses.zh: 他害怕，“如果樹倒了，她會把我吃掉的”
senses.en: “If the tree falls down, she will eat me up,” he was frightened.

records.text: usa riaxi! na riaxen ka, alu pakawasi yaaku

senses.zh: 去找吧！找到時回來告訴我
senses.en: Go looking for (her)! If (she) is found, come to let me know.

records.text: usa arai nisiw a ina alu dini a malaleng

senses.zh: 去帶你的母親來這兒住
senses.en: Go to bring your mother here to live (with us).

records.text: haw, usa riaxi pinarisan isiw a ina, aba!

senses.en: Alright, go and find your own parents!

records.text: usa di nita subud a kinixidan

senses.en: Go to the place near our spring.

records.text: usa lai siw mausay, mausay lia

senses.en: If you go, I will go too.

senses.en: (I) shall go looking for my mother.
intended to go, but did not go

notes: [Note: *ini aku mukusa，否定句人稱不移前這點和其他語言大不相同]

senses.en: Then they went there to take a look.

records.text: mukusa talima xumak maakuas nisia ina

senses.en: She went home alone and told her mother.

records.text: hakezeng a saw mukusa mataru a reten

senses.en: The old man went to Puli.

records.text: mukusa lai ki nimisiw a reten a saw, mikita lia

senses.zh: 那男人的村人都去看他們
senses.en: The man's villagers went to look at them.

records.text: dusa a batan, mukusa masikarum di binayu

senses.en: The two friends went to the mountain.

records.text: liaka mukusa di namisiw a xumag a taubaret, muriax adang a rubang a mamais kalayu sen ki langat

senses.zh: 她就到她家的鄰居找到一個姑娘，名叫 Kalayu
senses.en: She went to her neighbors and found a young lady named Kalayu.
I shall go looking for a place.
He was planning to go to the mountains.
